notable_exclusions_summary: Multi-variant indemnity plan (Preferred / Premier / Plus / Accumulate / Protect) with PED waiting graded by variant (24 / 36 / 48 months). Maternity, New Born, and First Year Vaccinations have linked waiting periods. NCB up to 200% of SI cap. Standard IRDAI permanent exclusions; Worldwide and Critical Illness available in higher variants.
